def pick(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> int:
    """Deterministically pick an element of xs from seed: the same xs and seed always give the same element. The index is seed modulo the length of xs, so seeds 0, 1, 2, ... walk through the list and wrap around."""
    pre xs.len() > 0
    post out in xs
    ex pick([10, 20, 30], 0) == 10
    ex pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
    ex pick([7], 12345) == 7
    n = xs.len()
    r = seed % n
    if r < 0:
        r += n
    return xs[r]
